_about: Follow-up tables reached through an event's 'follow' key. Each result is a further subject-less sentence appended to the triggering event. Original content written for DCUGen.

tragedy.text: Spent the following year numb, going through the motions.
Turned the grief into a cause and has never stopped working for it.
tragedy.motive: Making sure nobody else suffers the same loss.

tragedy.regret: Believing the tragedy could have been prevented.

tragedy.text: Found out later it was no accident.
tragedy.hook: New evidence suggests the old tragedy was deliberate.
tragedy.motive: Finding out who was really responsible.

tragedy.text: Leaned on friends for the first time and found out who they really were.
Moved away to escape the memories and never went back.
Started drinking to get through the nights.

complication.text: Drinks to quiet old grief, more than {name} admits.

tragedy.text: Received an insurance settlement that felt like blood money.
Was interviewed by every news outlet in the city and hated it.
Kept one object from the wreckage and carries it still.
tragedy.keepsake: a scorched keepsake salvaged from the worst day of {their} life

tragedy.text: Was offered help by a stranger who seemed to know far too much about what happened.
Got a phone call months later from someone claiming the dead were not really dead.
tragedy.hook: Someone thought lost in the tragedy may still be alive.

tragedy.text: Has never spoken about it since, not even to family.
Lost the ability to sleep through a thunderstorm.
Funded a memorial that still stands in {hometown}.
Started having vivid dreams about it, dreams with details {they_were} never told.
Watched the person responsible walk free on a technicality.

complication.text: The person who caused it walked free, and {name} knows the address.

tragedy.text: Was carried through it by a support group and still goes on Thursdays.

windfall.text: Gave most of it away to {church} and the neighbors.
Blew it all in eighteen glorious months.
Invested it wisely and lives modestly off the interest.
Drew the attention of relatives {they_were} never knew {they} had.
Paid off a parent's debts and quietly kept the rest for emergencies.
Got targeted by con artists, and learned more about scams than {they'd} ever wanted.
Used it to fund a {clinic|gym|community workshop|legal aid office}.
Bought a building with a secret basement the previous owner never mentioned.
windfall.hook: The secret basement has a door that was welded shut from the inside.

windfall.text: Was sued over it by an ex who claimed a share.
Was traced back by a mysterious patron who had been watching for years.
Spent a chunk of it on gear and training, 'just in case.'
Discovered the money had been marked by the police in an old case.
windfall.hook: A detective has started asking where the money came from.

underworld.text: Started as a lookout and moved up to running packages.
Became the crew's driver, the one who never panicked.
Was the crew's muscle, which paid well until it didn't.
Handled the books for a loan shark and learned where the money really goes.
Picked locks and cracked safes for a fence named {npc}.

person.who: {npc}, a fence who still moves anything for a price

underworld.text: Ran cons on rich marks and got good at being someone else.
Got out after a job went wrong and somebody died.
underworld.secret: Was present when a robbery turned deadly.

underworld.text: Got arrested and kept {their} mouth shut, earning a reputation as solid.
Snitched to save {themself}, and the crew suspects it.

complication.text: The old crew suspects {name} talked to the cops.

underworld.text: Worked as an enforcer for {gang} and still has the tattoo.

complication.text: Carries a {gang} tattoo that marks {them} to anyone in the life.

underworld.text: Was pulled out by a social worker who refused to give up on {them}.

person.who: {npc}, the social worker who pulled {name} out of the gang life
person.status: Overworked, underpaid and still fighting for kids nobody else wants.

underworld.text: Rose fast and made the crew a lot of money, and some powerful friends.
Ran numbers for a bookie and learned every corner of the city.
Was used as a courier for a costumed villain's operation without knowing who the boss was.
underworld.hook: The courier routes are being used again, and {name} recognizes the pattern.

underworld.text: Ended up owing the crew a favor that has never been called in.

complication.text: Owes an unpaid favor to the underworld.

underworld.text: Learned to fight dirty in back-alley brawls behind {bar}.

prison.text: Kept {their} head down and did the time.
Earned a degree through the prison education program.
Joined a prison gang for protection, and is still a member on paper.
Was cellmates with a costumed villain who talked in {their} sleep.
prison.hook: The villain's cellmate knows the location of a hidden stash.

prison.text: Was released early after a lawyer found the case had been botched.
Learned to fight in the yard, the hard way.
Found religion in a prison chapel.
Made a friend inside who is still serving a life sentence.

person.status: Still inside; writes long letters about books.

prison.text: Spent months in solitary after a riot {they_were} blamed for.
Came out with a record that closes doors and a network that opens others.

complication.text: A criminal record makes landlords, employers and cops wary.

military.text: Served as an infantry rifleman on two tours.
Trained as a combat medic and patched up friends under fire.
Drove supply convoys through hostile country.
Flew helicopters until a hard landing ended {their} flying days.

complication.text: An old back injury from a hard landing flares up at the worst times.

military.text: Was a military police officer who investigated crimes on base.
Served in signals intelligence and still can't talk about most of it.
military.secret: Holds classified knowledge from military intelligence work.

military.text: Was selected for special operations training and passed.
Was a combat engineer who cleared mines and built bridges.
Was decorated for valor after holding a position alone for hours.
Came home with PTSD and a long road back.

complication.text: Combat flashbacks triggered by smoke, gunfire or helicopters.

military.text: Was given a dishonorable discharge for refusing an unlawful order.

complication.text: Dishonorably discharged, and the official story isn't the true one.

military.text: Was part of a unit exposed to an experimental compound during 'routine inoculations.'
military.hook: Members of the old unit are developing strange abilities.

military.text: Served on a naval vessel and saw most of the world from the deck.
Was a sniper with a long list of confirmed shots and a short list of people to talk to about it.
Served as a peacekeeper and watched a ceasefire fall apart.
Lost a squad-mate, {npc}, in an ambush that still haunts {them}.
military.regret: Not being able to save {npc} in the ambush.

military.text: Mustered out with an honorable discharge and a sergeant's stripes.
Worked with a costumed hero on a joint operation and saw how different the rules were.

person.who: {hero}, a costumed hero {name} fought beside overseas
person.status: Owes {name} a favor from that operation.

faith.text: Joined {church} and found a community that felt like family.
Became a lay minister who visits prisons and hospitals.
Went on a pilgrimage that changed {their} sense of what matters.
Practices quietly, privately and every single day.
Fell in with a fervent splinter group that preached about the coming of 'the gifted.'
Studied with a monk who taught stillness as a weapon.
Became convinced that heroes and villains are signs of the end times.
Kept the faith but lost faith in the institution.
Was asked to perform an exorcism and found out the hard way that some aren't metaphors.
Became the person neighbors call when they need someone to pray with them at 3 a.m.

injury.text: Recovered completely, with a scar and a story.
Was left with a limp that comes and goes with the weather.

complication.text: An old leg injury slows {them} down in the cold.

injury.text: Got hooked on painkillers during recovery.

complication.text: Fighting a painkiller dependency that started in a hospital bed.

injury.text: Pushed through physical therapy with a stubbornness that surprised the doctors.
Lost partial hearing in one ear.
Had metal pins put in one arm that set off airport scanners forever after.
Woke from surgery remembering things that never happened to {them}.
Healed far faster than any doctor could explain.
injury.hook: A doctor kept samples from {name}'s too-fast recovery.

injury.text: Was left with chronic pain and a short temper.

complication.text: Chronic pain shortens an already short fuse.

injury.text: Fell in love with the physical therapist.

person.who: {npc}, the physical therapist who got {name} back on {their} feet

travel.text: Picked up a second language well enough to argue in it.
Got robbed in a train station and learned to trust instincts over guidebooks.
Spent weeks in a remote monastery and left calmer than {they_were} arrived.
Fell in with smugglers for one memorable border crossing.
Saw something in a ruined temple that {they} still cannot explain.
travel.hook: An artifact from the ruined temple has turned up at an auction in {city}.

travel.text: Made a lifelong friend in a hostel kitchen, {npc}.

person.who: {npc}, a friend met while traveling abroad
person.status: Lives overseas; always has a couch ready.

travel.text: Worked odd jobs in a dozen cities and could survive almost anywhere.
Was briefly detained by a foreign intelligence service that seemed to know {their} name already.
travel.hook: A foreign intelligence service has a file on {name}.

travel.text: Volunteered at a disaster relief camp and learned triage on the job.
Came home broke, sunburned and happier than ever.

patron.text: The benefactor has since paid for schooling, a car and one very discreet lawyer, and has never shown a face.

person.name: '{first}'
person.who: a faceless benefactor who signs typed letters only as '{first}'
person.status: Still sending letters, each with a small favor attached.

patron.text: The patron turned out to be a retired costumed hero looking for a successor.

person.who: {npc}, a retired hero once known as {hero}
person.status: Retired, ailing and watching {name}'s career closely.

patron.text: The patron turned out to be a costumed villain cultivating a future asset.

person.who: {villain}, a villain who has secretly bankrolled {name} for years
person.status: Waiting for the right moment to collect.

complication.text: Some of {their} resources were bankrolled by a villain.

patron.text: The patron is a reclusive billionaire with an interest in 'exceptional people.'

person.who: {npc}, a reclusive billionaire who collects exceptional people
person.status: Calls once a year to check on the investment.

patron.text: The patron is an old secret society that recruits one person per generation.
patron.hook: The society has sent someone to test whether {name} is worthy.

patron.text: The patron is a government program that thinks of {name} as an asset.

complication.text: A government program considers {name} its asset and expects cooperation.

patron.text: The patron has never been identified, and the money stopped coming last year.
patron.hook: The anonymous money stopped, and the last letter said only 'Run.'
